sara-sales: ByteWave POC hit intermittent 429s during a stress pass at 13:05 PT. Can ops/eng triage?

alex-eng: Please paste a failing request_id and any response headers (X-Redwood-Quota-*) from their logs.

sara-sales: One: request_id=rwd-bx123, route=/v1/chat/completions, status=429, body={"error":"rate_limited","request_id":"rwd-bx123","retry_after":3} plus no extra headers in their snapshot.

mike-ops: Telemetry shows ~11 parallel requests ~650 tokens each in ~3s -> brief spike to ~7.15k tokens. Default per-route token cap = 6k/5s, so quota triggered.

jules-ml: They also confirmed doing an embedding per message for rerank; that multiplies token usage. Recommend caching or async embedding prep.

emily-sa: Suggest temporary token bump while they validate and a quick harness tweak: max_concurrency=8, max_tokens=350. Want a 48h bump?

mike-ops: Applied a 48h per-tenant token bump (6k->12k tokens/5s). Logged ticket RB-4520 and enabled short monitoring window.

alex-eng: Also ask them to include X-Redwood-Request-Id and X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining on future 429s; that'll speed triage. We recommend permanent changes: lower max_tokens, cache embeddings, or move embedding to background worker.

sara-sales: I'll send the checklist and have them rerun in ~30m. Will paste logs here. :thumbsup:
